nights.title: The Fray - Autumn Light Tour

Their debut studio album, How to Save a Life (2005) was released by Epic Records and received quadruple platinum certification by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA), as well as platinum certification in Australia, Canada, New Zealand and the United Kingdom. Its release was supported by their first hit single, "Over My Head ", which peaked at number eight on the Billboard Hot 100. nights.title: glaive - God Save The Three Tour
nights.name: Glaive
nights.extract: Ash Blue Gutierrez, known professionally as Glaive, is an American singer-songwriter. After posting a string of hyperpop songs to SoundCloud during the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic that earned him a following, he signed a record deal with Interscope Records and released his debut extended play, Cypress Grove, in 2020. His debut album, I Care So Much That I Don't Care at All, was released in 2023. His second album, May It Never Falter, was released in 2024. His third, Y'all, was released in September 2025. His fourth, a collaborative album with Kurtains called God Save the Three, was released in May 2026.

nights.title: EsDeeKid - Council House Rat Tour
nights.name: EsDeeKid
nights.extract:
EsDeeKid is a British rapper from Liverpool, England. He released his debut mixtape, Rebel, in June 2025. He has been noted as a prominent figure in the UK underground rap scene. His music is characterised by his thick Scouse accent and draws inspiration from cloud rap. He covers his face with a balaclava, and keeps his name, appearance, and age private. He still lives in his council house.
As of May 2026, EsDeeKid's single "Phantom" has accumulated more than 300 million streams. His mixtape Rebel has charted in multiple European countries, as well as peaked at number 23 on the US Billboard 200, despite being released nearly five months before its debut on the chart.

de.who: Tiffany Day Ruan ist eine kanadisch-amerikanische Sängerin, Songwriterin und Musikproduzentin. In Wichita, Kansas, aufgewachsen, begann sie unabhängig Musik zu veröffentlichen, nachdem ein Video von 2017 mit ihr, wie sie in einen Brunnen in Italien singt, auf Twitter viral ging.
facts: Ihr Debütalbum Lover Tofu Fruit erschien 2024.

tr.who: Tiffany Day Ruan, Kanadalı-Amerikalı bir şarkıcı, söz yazarı ve müzik yapımcısıdır. Kansas'ın Wichita kentinde büyüdü; 2017'de İtalya'da bir kuyuya şarkı söylediği bir videosu Twitter'da viral olduktan sonra bağımsız olarak müzik yayımlamaya başladı.
facts: Debut stüdyo albümü Lover Tofu Fruit'u 2024 yılında yayımladı.
2026'da Broke Records üzerinden ikinci stüdyo albümü Halo'yu yayımladı.

nights.title: MICO - IN:BETWEEN TOUR
nights.name: Mico
nights.extract: Jose Miguel Veloso, known professionally as Mico, is a Canadian singer-songwriter and musician from Toronto. He initially grew a fanbase online through Discord and Twitch, breaking out commercially with his 2022 single "cut my hair", which became a top-30 radio hit in Canada. In 2025, he signed with Columbia Records following a string of independent extended plays.

de.who: Jose Miguel Veloso, unter dem Künstlernamen Mico bekannt, ist ein kanadischer Singer-Songwriter und Musiker aus Toronto. Zunächst baute er über Discord und Twitch eine Fanbase im Netz auf.
facts: Mit seiner Single „cut my hair“ aus dem Jahr 2022 brach er kommerziell durch; sie wurde in Kanada ein Top-30-Radiohit.
Im Jahr 2025 unterschrieb er bei Columbia Records, nachdem er eine Reihe unabhängiger EPs veröffentlicht hatte.

tr.who: Jose Miguel Veloso, sahne adıyla Mico, Toronto'dan bir Kanadalı şarkıcı-söz yazarı ve müzisyendir. Önce Discord ve Twitch üzerinden çevrimiçi bir hayran kitlesi oluşturdu.
facts: 2022 yılındaki "cut my hair" single'ı ile ticari anlamda çıkış yaptı; bu şarkı Kanada'da ilk 30 radyo hiti oldu.
2025 yılında, bir dizi bağımsız EP'nin ardından Columbia Records ile anlaşma imzaladı.
